:::{#thm-disjunctive-syllogism}
#### Disjunctive syllogism

For [propositions](#def-proposition) $P$ and $Q$,
this is a [rule of inference](#def-rule-of-inference):

$$
\frac{P \lor Q, \quad \neg P}{Q}
$$

:::

::: proof

Suppose both [premises](#def-premise) are true.
By the definition of [not](#def-not),
$P$ is false.
By the definition of [or](#def-or),
$P \lor Q$ is true
only if $P$ is true or $Q$ is true.
So the [conclusion](#def-conclusion) $Q$ is true.

:::
